summary: Retested public auth, role permissions, 9-chair board, isolated quick-add, occupied status update, and cancellation after the PATCH payload fix.

minor.issue: test_create_multislot_conflict_cancel_rebook uses fixed 2099-01-01 data and fails on repeat with 409; shared test data is not cleaned up.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking the visible Live activity button leaves the user on Today’s chair board and no activity/history view is rendered.

issues: The 9-chair board remains horizontally scrollable on narrow screens; this is usable but not a condensed mobile layout.

action_items: Make Live activity navigate to a history/activity view or remove/disable the unfinished control.
Use unique dates and cleanup fixtures in backend regression tests.
Run a two-page WebSocket propagation test after any board navigation changes.
critical_code_review_comments: The activity navigation control is rendered as an interactive button but has no onClick or alternate view, creating a dead-end user flow.
The regression suite is not repeatable against the shared database because it leaves fixed-date bookings behind.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested auth/create/status/cancel flows; activity navigation gap reported

seed_data_creation: Created and cancelled isolated E2E bookings on future dates; cancelled rows remain available through the backend history endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh reception login, cookie /me, 9-chair board, quick-add, occupied status update, and cancellation passed. Live activity button is nonfunctional. WebSocket two-page propagation was not rerun in this iteration.
rca of the issue: App.js renders activity-nav-button without state, navigation, or handler; the button only changes styling on click and Board always renders the schedule. The backend history endpoint exists, but no frontend consumer exists.
